title: Prior releases validated.
bodyText: All releases of powers made prior to May 16, 1947, which substantially comply with the requirements of section 512-1 are validated.
bodyHtml: §512-2  Prior releases validated.  All releases of powers made prior to May 16, 1947, which substantially comply with the requirements of section 512-1 are validated. [L 1947, c 126, §2; RL 1955, §198-2; HRS §512-2]
